# UMSU International

> > UMSU International supports international students at the University of Melbourne through programs, events, and student organizations.

UMSU International is the international student arm of the University of Melbourne Student Union (UMSU), providing leadership opportunities like the International Student Ambassador (ISA) Program, cultural events through affiliated clubs like MUHKSA, and comprehensive support services funded by SSAF for international students on the Unimelb campus.

## Key Topics

- University of Melbourne
- UMSU International
- ISA Program (International Student Ambassador)
- SSAF (Student Services and Amenities Fee)
- International student support
- MUHKSA (Hong Kong Students Association)
- Student leadership and volunteering
- Orientation events
- Campus cultural activities
- Melbourne student life
- Student organizations and clubs
- Arts and Cultural Building
- Application processes
